Procedure Name.value: Liu et al. (2025) Experimental Sulfide LA-ICP-MS Spot v1

Procedure Author.cell: Liu, Li, Xu, Xiong et al.
Procedure Author.value: Liu, Li, Xu, Xiong et al.

Laboratory.cell: State Key Laboratory of Isotope Geochemistry, Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, CAS, China
Laboratory.value: State Key Laboratory of Isotope Geochemistry, Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, CAS, China

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: Strategic Priority Research Program (B) CAS; NSFC 92062222, 42073057, 42250710679, 42250202, 42273023
Funding Source for Procedure Development.value: Strategic Priority Research Program (B) CAS; NSFC 92062222, 42073057, 42250710679, 42250202, 42273023

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Liu et al. (2025) GCA 393, 170; Xu et al. (2022)
Procedure Reference(s).value: Liu et al. (2025) GCA 393, 170; Xu et al. (2022)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Phase (quenched sulfide of one experimental run) > Spot — "20 μm for sulfides, selecting grain sizes larger than 20 µm for the latter" (p.4); Au and Cu contents are reported per run (Table 1, p.3)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Phase (quenched sulfide of one experimental run) > Spot

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Same capsule section as silicate glass; sulfide grains ≥20 µm selected by SEM-BSE
Sample Preparation Method.value: Same capsule section as silicate glass; sulfide grains ≥20 µm selected by SEM-BSE

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Size — "20 μm for sulfides, selecting grain sizes larger than 20 µm for the latter" (p.4), so a sulfide grain is analysed only if it is wider than the beam

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Optical microscopy, then EMP — "Following examination by optical microscopy to ascertain the integrity of the experiments and the state of the oxygen buffers, the solid components of the run products were analysed for major elements, S and Cu, using a JEOL JXA-8230 electron microprobe (EMP)" (p.2); those EMP values are then the internal standards for the LA data, "with Si and Fe obtained from EMP analyses as the internal standards" (p.4)

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Resonetics 193 nm ArF excimer laser (coupled to Cetac Analyte HE system; same system as glass protocol)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Resonetics 193 nm ArF excimer laser (coupled to Cetac Analyte HE system; same system as glass protocol)

Ablation Cell Type.cell: Cetac Analyte HE system (same as silicate glass protocol)
Ablation Cell Type.value: Cetac Analyte HE system (same as silicate glass protocol)

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: 20 µm circular (sulfide; grain sizes >20 µm selected)

Ablation Duration per Spot.cell: ~40 s (same protocol; grain size >20 µm selected)
Ablation Duration per Spot.value: ~40 s (same protocol; grain size >20 µm selected)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He (flow rate not stated; same system as glass protocol)
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He (flow rate not stated; same system as glass protocol)

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: N₂ or Ar mixed (same protocol as glass)
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: N₂ or Ar mixed (same protocol as glass)

Analysis Sequence.cell: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol
Analysis Sequence.value: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol

Target Species.cell: ¹⁹⁷Au, ⁶³Cu (primary targets; Si and Fe from EMP as internal standards)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Au and Cu contents of the quenched sulfide (ppm) per run (Table 1, p.3), which with the coexisting glass give the reported sulfide/melt partition coefficient DAu (dimensionless, p.2)

value.member: Au and Cu contents of the quenched sulfide (ppm) per run
which with the coexisting glass give the reported sulfide/melt partition coefficient DAu

Inter-Pass Data Dependency.cell: Single spot per location (sulfides; same acquisition parameters as glass but 20 µm spot)

Number of Replicates.cell: N (grain size >20 µm selected; number of analyzed grains variable)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Single element from EMP: Fe (FeOT from EMP for sulfide); NIST 610 as external standard

Internal Standard Element.cell: Fe from EMP (FeOT wt% for sulfide)

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: Femtosecond laser reduces LIEF; NIST 610 external standard; Fe IS from EMP corrects for ablation yield; micronuggets identified from Au signal spikes and excluded from integration

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Same approach as glass; micronugget identification from Au signal spikes critical for sulfide analyses
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Same approach as glass; micronugget identification from Au signal spikes critical for sulfide analyses

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Same approach as glass; Au spike identification critical for determining solubility vs. nugget contribution
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Same approach as glass; Au spike identification critical for determining solubility vs. nugget contribution

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: No post-acquisition normalization beyond IS (Fe from EMP)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — no rule for admitting or rejecting individual results is stated. The one documented exclusion is at sample level and before analysis: "Capsules that had lost significant weight were discarded" after the leak check (p.2)

Combination Method.cell: N — Table 1 gives 'one standard deviation' in parentheses, but not what it is taken over

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: NIST 610 (primary external standard); Fe from EMP as IS

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: NIST SRM 612 and BCR-2G (same monitoring standard set as glass protocol)

Detection Limit.cell: N (detection limits for sulfide not stated; only silicate melt detection limits given as Au ~0.01 ppm, Cu ~0.1 ppm)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: Sulfide Au and Cu concentrations consistent with strong positive correlation with log fS₂ (Fig. 5A) confirming thermodynamic equilibrium; partitioning coefficients Dsulfide/melt consistent with literature (Li et al. 2019, 2021)

Additional Notes.cell: Analysis of quenched experimental pyrrhotite (Fe₁₋ₓS) from same piston-cylinder experiments; 20 µm spot required due to small grain size (5–50 µm); same instrument and analytical session as glass protocol
Additional Notes.value: Analysis of quenched experimental pyrrhotite (Fe₁₋ₓS) from same piston-cylinder experiments; 20 µm spot required due to small grain size (5–50 µm); same instrument and analytical session as glass protocol
